description: This file defines the HolidayRepository interface for accessing Holiday entities from the database, including custom queries for retrieving holidays based on office ID, date, status, and processing state.

classes.name: HolidayRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Holiday entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByOfficeIdAndGreaterThanDate
methods.description: Retrieves a list of holidays for a specific office where the holiday dates are on or after a given date and match a specific status.

methods.name: findUnprocessed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of holidays that are not yet processed and match a specific status.
